description: An application submitted under Section 73 of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a Minor Material Amendment in connection with the planning permission (DC/23/130227) dated 3 November 2023, for the variation of Conditions, 2 (Approved Plans), 5 (Internal Sound Insulation), 8 (Refuse & Recycling Facilities), 9 (Cycle Parking Facilities), 10 (Living Roof), 15 (Internal Refurbishment Works) in order to allow; alterations to the layouts at ground, first, second and third floor levels, the relocation of two windows in the north elevation, an alternative living roof system, changes to the noise standards for the noise limiter and changes to the triggers for the submission of details for conditions 5 and 15 at Montague Arms, 289 Queens Road SE15.
